title: Challenges in biogas valorization, effect of impurities on dry reforming process during H2 generation: a review
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00099H, Review Article
Mahdi Mohamad Ali, Vishal Dutta, Hélène Guy, Sylvain Durécu, Edmond Abi-Aad, Carmen Ciotonea, Cédric Gennequin
The review investigates the effects biogas contaminants such as H2S, siloxanes, O2, H2O, VOCs on the dry reforming process.
